//: The class list read by tools/check-classes.mjs. Binding: see docs/CLASSES.md.
//2: A record's class is OPEN (redistributable in a commercial build) or GATED (not redistributable). There is no third class and no 'probably fine'.
//3: kernel_const_expressible answers one question: may this record be compiled into the shipped binary? It must be false for every GATED record, and the checker fails if it is true.
//4: state is one of: present | seam_only | absent. must_exist says whether the build is allowed to be without it yet; the checker fails in BOTH directions.
//5: classifier must be a name, never 'the team' and never blank: a legal conclusion with no author is not a conclusion.

records.title: Opaque-body constants: mu, equatorial radius, J2, rotation rate, flattening
records.publisher: IAU Working Group on Cartographic Coordinates; JPL/EGM
records.notes: Four bodies only, and every field carries its Prov. Values are published constants, not a survey product, so there is no distributor-versus-publisher trap here.

records.title: Planetary and lunar ephemerides, DE440 / DE441
records.notes: Permits commercial use with no fee, but NOT 'public domain': the recipient indemnifies Caltech and NASA, and the export classification is TSPA. The indemnity needs a legal read before a paid release, which is why commercial_ok is not a bare 'yes'.

records.title: Asteroid and comet orbits, ~1.3 M objects
Confirmed exoplanet catalogue, ~6,000 objects
records.notes: Open access, but the exact terms page has not been quoted verbatim into the manifest yet. 'needs-authorisation' until it is: this entry is the reminder that a plausible-looking open archive is still a claim to be read.

records.title: Pan-STARRS1 star catalogues
records.notes: The survey is consortium-owned while the STScI grant is broad, so the grant must be quoted verbatim in the manifest rather than paraphrased.

records.title: Tycho-2 catalogue, NASA ADC mirror
records.attribution: NASA ADC mirror of the Tycho-2 Catalogue (ESA)
records.notes: The single clearest case of licence-follows-the-distributor: the same tables from CDS/ESA are GATED (hipparcos-tycho-esa). If the bytes came from a different door, this classification is void.

records.title: Gaia DR3 astrometry
records.notes: May only arrive through a Survey implementation the player installs. Never a shipped default, never a const in the kernel.

records.title: Hipparcos and Tycho catalogues, ESA/CDS distribution
records.notes: The trap DATA-LICENSING.md section 1 exists for: 'pre-Gaia is safe' is false.

records.title: Unclassified records mirrored via CDS / VizieR
records.notes: Assume CC BY-NC until proven otherwise. A record that cannot be classified does not ship.

records.title: Lumped thermal network and vapour-compression heat-pump correlation
records.publisher: derived: first-principles energy balance + Copeland COP correlation
records.attribution: Stefan-Boltzmann constant per the 2019 SI redefinition; Copeland COP correlation as published in the HVAC literature
records.notes: No dataset: the physical constants are exact by definition and the correlations are equations, not tables. Deliberately ships no standard-atmosphere table (that is the separate `atmosphere-1976` record, which remains absent) and no thermodynamic property data (`thermo-cea`, also absent). The empirical inputs are one calibration (the second-law efficiency, chosen to reproduce a nameplate) and one published coefficient (ASHRAE's cyclic degradation C_d, 0.04-0.25). Both are carried as `Assumed` quantities with their basis, not as measured values; the two `Measured` quantities are the nameplate pair, and they are appliance data, not a licensed dataset.
